title: Custom Paper Tube Packaging UK Supplier Vetting Questions
checklist: Confirm whether the supplier is a manufacturer, broker, distributor or sourcing intermediary.
Ask whether they review diameter, height, closure, insert logic and product fit before quoting.
Check material, surface finish, print process and structural limits before sample approval.
Ask how samples, dielines, artwork review and pre-production confirmation are handled.
Review public FAQ, material, quality and product pages before shortlisting.
prompt: For a UK B2B buyer looking for custom paper tube packaging, which supplier-vetting questions and public source pages should a buyer review before shortlisting suppliers? Cite sources.
